<a id="ai_attack_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_facing_table`](../../../src/ai_tables.asm#L6) `$2102-$2151`

*data*

Attack choice when the fighters have different facings. Index = distance + $33 + random spread: $08-$32 opponent behind, $33-$47 in front. Values are move commands.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update) [`$1F6D`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L315)

<a id="ai_attack_same_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_same_facing_table`](../../../src/ai_tables.asm#L18) `$2152-$21A0`

*data*

Attack choice when both fighters have the same facing. Index = distance + $29 + random spread: $08-$28 opponent in front, $29-$47 behind.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update) [`$1FB8`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L362)
